name: VRM_POL_SATISFACTION_EVENTS_GT
description: This is a temporary table which is used internally by Oracle.

columns.name: POL_SATISFACTION_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Satisfaction measurement event unique identifier.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_LINE_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation line identifier.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_SUB_LINE_ID
columns.description: Source document subline unique identifier to which this satisfaction event relates.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_MEASUREMENT_NUM
columns.description: Sequence number for the satisfaction measurement record.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_MEASUREMENT_DATE
columns.description: The date on which the satisfaction is measured.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_PERIOD_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the period satisfied. Used only when the model is measure period satisfied.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_PERIOD_END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the period satisfied. Used only when the model is measure period satisfied.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_QUANTITY
columns.description: Specifies the quantity satisfied on the measurement date. Used only when the model is measure quantity satisfied. The default value is the fulfilled quantity of the source document line.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_PERCENT
columns.description: Specifies the percentage satisfied on the measurement date.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_AMOUNT
columns.description: NA

columns.name: DISCARDED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this satisfaction measurement event was discarded.

columns.name: DISCARDED_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the date on which this satisfaction measurement event is discarded.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_FROM
columns.description: The process or user interface from which this row is created.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_PERIOD_PROPORTION
columns.description: If the satisfaction measurement model is Measure Period Satisfied then the value for this field will be derived from the revenue schedule provided for the performance obligation line.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Source document line.

columns.name: PERIOD_NUMBER
columns.description: Sequence of the period number while creating the satisfaction events. Used for internal processing.

columns.name: FIRST_PERIOD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether current satisfaction event is related to the first period.

columns.name: LAST_PERIOD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the current satisfaction event is related to the last period.

columns.name: DISCARDED_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that discarded this row.

columns.name: SPLIT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this satisfaction measurement event was split because of a mid-month termination while processing an immaterial change.

columns.name: PROCESSED_PERIOD_PROPORTION
columns.description: Proportion of the satisfaction event period before the contract modification date.

columns.name: PROCESSED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this satisfaction event is processed or not. Blank indicates processed. N indicates not processed.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_EVENT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Used during internal processing to identify whether the satisfaction event is newly created or not.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_SE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Additional satisfaction event used in the rule. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_ADDL_SATIS_EVENTS.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_EVENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether satisfaction event is a primary satisfaction event or additional satisfaction event.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ADDITIONAL_SLINE_ID
columns.description: Source document additional subline unique identifier to which this additional satisfaction event is related.

columns.name: ASE_PROCESS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the additional satisfaction event is validated against the primary satisfaction event. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: ASE_SPLIT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the primary satisfaction event is split based on the additional satisfaction event. Valid values are Y and N.
